description: Invites an address into a company with a preset — viewer reads, client reads and hands pieces over, accountant keeps the books, owner also administers — and any capability granted on top of it. It returns a token once and stores only its hash, so hand the token to the person you invited: they accept it themselves, signed in with that address. It does not send an e-mail, and it does not create an account. Inviting the same address again withdraws the invitation that was pending.

capabilities.description: Capability codes granted on top of the preset, e.g. members.manage. get_company lists what this installation knows.

company_id.description: The company to work in. Ask list_companies if unsure.

email.description: The address the invitation is for. Matched when it is accepted.

role.description: The preset. Default viewer, which reads and changes nothing. client is the person whose company it is, invited by whoever keeps their books: it reads the same, and may also hand a file over (documents.deposit).

name: invite_member
title: Invite somebody into a company
